capella.variety.subtle.desc: A bay more or less, a little wider or taller.
capella.variety.wild.desc: Bigger changes, and some choices (east end, towers, piers...) re-picked.
capella.hint.grid: Click to use · Right-click to pick
capella.tooltip.reseed: Same settings, a new seed (changes the stone mix)
capella.tooltip.variations: See several versions of this building side by side
capella.tooltip.reset: Put every setting back to this building's defaults (keeps the seed)
capella.tooltip.place: Build it where you're looking (or at your feet): the west door goes there and the nave runs the way you face. /capella undo takes it back.
capella.tooltip.place_disabled: Needs a world and creative mode
capella.save.title: Save building
capella.preset.chapel.desc: A buttressed chapel with paired lights, a rose over the door and a bellcote.
capella.preset.parish.desc: A broach spire on the west tower, porch, chancel and a great east window.
capella.preset.abbey.desc: Round arches, heavy cylindrical piers and a squat crossing tower.
capella.preset.cathedral.desc: The classic: aisled nave, transept, apse, twin west spires and a crossing spire.
capella.preset.minster.desc: Two transepts, each crossing with its own tower.
capella.preset.dark.desc: Wide, tight-bayed and flamboyant, with saddleback towers and sexpartite vaults.
capella.preset.great.desc: Double aisles, an ambulatory with radiating chapels, and clustered piers.
capella.preset.colossal.desc: Every parameter at its maximum. Big: expect a few seconds to generate.
capella.preset.westtower.desc: A tall English tower: angle buttresses, a deep portal, a louvred belfry and pinnacled battlements.
capella.preset.spiretower.desc: A great tower with a needle spire set inside its parapet, lucarnes at the spire's foot.
capella.preset.belfry.desc: A broad saddleback belfry tower in dark stone.
capella.preset.wayside.desc: A tiny single-cell chapel with a bellcote and plain lancets.
capella.preset.village.desc: Nave and lower chancel, a battlemented west tower and a south porch.
capella.preset.tower.desc: A free-standing tower with a louvred belfry and a spire.
capella.big.title: That's a big one
capella.big.message: This building is %s (%s blocks). Building it here takes a while and can lag the game. For something this size, Save it as a .schem and paste it with Axiom instead: it's much faster.
